// Fixture for the mutation operators: one construct per line, numbered below.
export function pick(xs: Array<u8>, n: i32): u8 | null {
  if (n < 0 || n >= xs.length) {
    return null
  }
  const ok: boolean = !done(xs) && n == 3
  log("a < b && 7 == 7")
  /* n <= 2 || 9 */
  return xs[n]
}
export const twice = (x: i32): i32 => {
  return x * 2
}
